propositions: Close dispatch unconditionally invokes the completion provider via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket contains a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS op-cert pinned to the resolved close ref.
A valid ticket-contained attested PASS at the same resolved ref must be reused to eliminate redundant provider calls while preserving signed close and durable completion evidence.

The reuse check must validate cryptographic signature, authenticated SHA pin equality to resolved close target, material fingerprint currency, and absence of invalidation by later reopen before returning zero-provider PASS.
Ineligible records (absent attestation, invalid signature, stale material, changed ref, non-PASS kind, or post-reopen) must fall through to fresh provider verification.
The existing locked close and post-close signing path must remain unchanged when a reused PASS is returned.
